title: Outside rows run the checkout's krn hook and fail on a hook version mismatch
body:
Why: Fable 1115b slice 1; rows ran the installed krn hook, not the checkout (test-first replay attempt 2).
Outcome: the row harness puts the checkout krn first on PATH, records the hook version in the summary; mismatch fails the row.
Proof: regression test with a stale shim goes red. Free. Touches scripts/outside-acceptance.ts.
